title: Round 4: net2 by DAgger from a privileged teacher, three seeds
description: Every learned net2 so far stayed at the fixed rule: after 60 iterations the spread of its u across states was 0.02 to 0.03 (exp-net2-ppo-team-101, exp-net2-ppo-flows-102, exp-net2-td3bc-103), so the policy gradient from exploration noise of sigma 0.05 never found the state dependence the gate asks for. Here the signal is a label at every decision instead of a return: DAgger (Ross, Gordon and Bagnell, 2011; algo dagger in train/ppo.py). The teacher knows which flows share the link: it is the share rule on net1's mean beliefs (u0 = 0.25, push gain k) while a stock TCP flow is active, and the fixed rule (u = 0.25) otherwise, alone, with UDP or among copies. The student is the recurrent actor on net1's binned beliefs alone, as before; it acts in every rollout, each of its decisions is labelled with the teacher's u, and it regresses on the last 8 iterations' labels. It must infer from net1's output what the teacher is told. Teacher gain k = 1 or 2 (on validation the share rule gained 0.24 and 0.36 with Cubic from the start at these k, on net1 v4, and lost elsewhere, which the teacher's switch removes), learning rate 1e-3, the competition mix (80% of the links, Cubic, BBR or 2 or 4 copies), sigma = 0.05, seeds 1, 2 and 3, 60 iterations, on the held-u graph. The policies go to the round-4 gate. Validation links only.
run: S="$OUT/spec-r4dagger-k$K-s$SEED.json"; jq --argjson k "$K" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.algo = "dagger" | .base = "fixed" | .share_k = $k | .critic_warmup = 0 | .lr = 0.001 | .updates_per_iteration = 200 | .replay_iterations = 8 | .tau_s = 1 | .noise_sigma = 0.05 | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = 8 | .compete = 0.8 | .copies = [2, 4] | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 60 | .eval_every = 20' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r4dagger-k$K-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
